final:
-- The plugin reads through whatever fs it is given. Its second read
-- escapes the directory and must come back as "".
plugin(path: str) -> str uses fs =
  post out.split("|").len() >= 2
  ex plugin("missing.txt") == "|"
  let mine = fs.read(path) else ""
  let theirs = fs.read("notes/../secret.txt") else ""
  mine + "|" + theirs

-- Runs the plugin with fs confined to notes/, so path is relative to notes.
run_plugin(path: str) -> str uses fs =
  pre path.char_count() > 0
  post out.split("|").len() >= 2
  ex run_plugin("missing.txt") == "|"
  var result = ""
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    result = plugin(path)
  result
